purpose: Check overlap compatibility of conditioning-family restrictions without promoting pairwise compatibility to global descent.

overlap_semantics.overlap_compatible: Two conditioning-family restrictions agree on every shared presentation and every bounded local comparison inside a nontrivial overlap.
overlap_semantics.overlap_trivial_single_presentation: The common restriction consists of exactly one shared presentation.
overlap_semantics.no_shared_presentation: The two conditioning families do not overlap.
overlap_semantics.overlap_held: At least one local restriction is unresolved.
overlap_semantics.overlap_restriction_obstructed: At least one local restriction is already obstructed.
overlap_semantics.overlap_restriction_mismatch: The two local restriction presentations disagree on their common bounded semantics or fail to match the canonical v7.4 sector semantics.

sector_semantics.pairwise_overlap_coherent_stable_descent: All available overlaps are compatible and the source v7.5 sector is restriction-stable.
sector_semantics.pairwise_overlap_compatible_but_global_d: All generating overlap restrictions are compatible, yet the source sector remains globally obstructed.
All available overlap restrictions are compatible, yet global descent remains unresolved.
sector_semantics.overlap_compatibility_obstruction: A common restriction itself is obstructed or mismatched.
sector_semantics.generator_local_obstruction_precedes_ove: The source obstruction is already visible within one conditioning family.
sector_semantics.local_only_no_overlap: The sector is an isolated local presentation.

descent.next: one simultaneously selected compatible local family versus merely pairwise-compatible overlap witnesses
